title: Cisco agrees to buy optical-module maker Acacia for $2.6B

sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Cisco has agreed to acquire Acacia for $70.00 per share in cash, or for approximately $2.6 billion on a fully diluted basis, net of cash and marketable securities.

explain: Cisco first agreed to pay $70 a share (about $2.6 billion) for Acacia, which makes the optical modules that send data over fiber between data centers. A long wait for Chinese regulatory approval led the two sides to renegotiate, and the price was raised in January 2021.
